The Agentic Enterprise — and where I've already worked

AI customer agents only succeed when all four layers of the enterprise stack are sold, governed, and deployed together. I've carried quota at every one of them.

Layer 01

System of Context

The data foundation — identity, semantics, governance — that gives an agent something true to act on.

My ground: Primary Data360 (CDP) seller — one of the first CDP deals in Canada, plus data governance work inside Canada's largest grocery and financial ecosystem.
Layer 02

System of Work

The business logic and workflows agents execute against — journeys, processes, escalation paths.

My ground: Multi-cloud platform deployments at Roots Canada (7× ROI), League (10× new customer signings), and Harnois (40% post-promo purchase rate).
Layer 03

System of Agency

The AI agents themselves — and the governance deciding what they're allowed to do in production.

My ground: Pre-release Agentforce field evaluator — co-determined enterprise readiness of agent capabilities before general availability.
Layer 04

System of Engagement

Where humans and agents meet — the conversation surfaces customers and teams actually use.

My ground: Built Slack-integrated deal operations and reporting for a distributed enterprise team — without a RevOps resource.
